series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a downward trend with moderate strength and seasonal patterns, but high noise and unpredictability due to spectral entropy > 0.85. Concept drift and unstable rankings suggest avoiding complex combinations. A robust baseline approach (e.g., median) is recommended to handle the noisy, drifting signal.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true AND spectral_entropy=0.8516 → high noise level; robust_median is less sensitive to outliers and preferred for unpredictable series
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.0409) → unstable rankings; inverse_rmse_weights with shrinkage is robust to unstable rankings
